test_is_auth_error: test the _is_auth_error function from tools.mcp_tool to detect OAuthFlowError, OAuthNonInteractiveError, and httpx 401 responses
test_call_tool_handler_needs_reauth: test the _make_tool_handler function returns a structured needs_reauth error when an unrecoverable 401 occurs
test_call_tool_handler_generic_error: test the _make_tool_handler function returns a generic error for non-auth exceptions instead of needs_reauth
test_is_auth_error_rejects_non_auth: test the _is_auth_error function rejects non-authentication exceptions like ValueError and RuntimeError
test_is_auth_error_rejects_httpx_500: test the _is_auth_error function returns False for httpx HTTPStatusError with 500 status code
